response.justification: The candidate lacks demonstrated experience in GenAI, RAG architectures, vector databases, or cloud-based AI system deployment — core requirements for the role — and while they have broad full-stack experience, there is no evidence of 8+ years building production-grade AI solutions or leading technical discovery sessions with enterprise stakeholders.
strengths: Extensive full-stack development experience across multiple languages and platforms
Proven track record in open-source contributions and technical education
Strong DevOps and infrastructure skills with Docker, CI/CD, and cloud tooling
concerns: No evidence of GenAI, RAG, or vector database implementation experience
Lacks clear demonstration of enterprise AI product deployment or customer-facing technical leadership
AI-related work is limited to vague mentions of 'AI-agent infrastructure' without technical depth
